To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the preferred conformer of Dpg and Ac 7c is similar in solution, while the preferred conformer in the crystal state differs.
Dpg and Ac 7c had similar structure with acyclic and cyclical side chain, respectively.

the preferred conforma-tion of the dipropylglycinyl‐ and aminocycloheptyl‐containing peptides was a right‐handerd (P) helix in solution and in the crystal state, and the preferred conformation of dipropylgly-cinyl homopeptide was planar and that of aminocyclohaptyl homopeptide had a helical structure.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the conformational behavior of Dpg‐contained peptides in solution and in the solid state.
the synthesis of peptides containing dipropylglycin (Dpg) and 1‐aminocyloheptanacarboxilic acid (Ac7C) residues.
the conformation of peptides containing dipropylglycinyl‐ and 1‐aminocyloheptanoyl‐l‐leucine residues, which were designed and synthesized by our group.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the Dpg‐contained peptides adopt a right‐handerd (P) 3(10) helix, while Ac7c‐contained peptides adopt a right handerd (P) α helix in the solution state, and the Ac7c‐and Ac7c‐l‐Leu‐containing peptides have similar conformations in the solid state.
the Dpg and Ac‐7c‐containg l‐Leu peptide adopt the P 310‐helical structure in solution, and the P 310 helix is more stable than P 3 10 helix in solution.
Ac7c and Dpg have different preferred structures, but Dpg‐ and A7c‐contained l‐Leu residues have similar preferred conformations in solution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Ac7c‐ and Dpg‐contained peptides had similar conformations in solution.
the conformational preference of the peptides with Dpg or Ac7c was determined by the amino acid sequence and the side chain structure of the amino acids.

the preferred conformation of the peptides having Dpg or Ac7c residues within the sequence of Leu residues was similar, but that of the Dpg‐contained octapeptide was different from those of the other peptides.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the preferred conformation of the peptide in solution can be different from that in the crystal.
the preferred conformer of the Dpg‐containg octapeptide in a crystal state was different from those in solution.
the side‐chain conformation of a single residue within a sequence of residues can have a significant effect on the overall conformation of the peptide.
